title.es: Road trip por el sur de Europa
title.fr: Road trip en Europe du Sud
title.pt: Road trip pelo sul da Europa

summary.en: A 20-day cross-border road-trip template from Lisbon to Rome via Spain and southern France. The route is source-backed for licence, rental, toll and urban-access context; exact roads, travel times, fuel and toll totals remain date- and vehicle-dependent.
summary.de: Eine 20-tägige grenzüberschreitende Roadtrip-Vorlage von Lissabon nach Rom über Spanien und Südfrankreich. Führerschein-, Mietwagen-, Maut- und Zufahrtskontext sind quellenbasiert; konkrete Straßen, Fahrzeiten, Kraftstoff- und Mautkosten bleiben datum- und fahrzeugabhängig.
summary.it: Un modello di road trip transfrontaliero di 20 giorni da Lisbona a Roma passando per Spagna e Francia meridionale. Patente, noleggio, pedaggi e accessi urbani sono documentati; strade, tempi e costi dipendono da data e veicolo.
summary.es: Una plantilla de road trip transfronterizo de 20 días desde Lisboa hasta Roma pasando por España y el sur de Francia. Licencia, alquiler, peajes y accesos urbanos están documentados; carreteras, tiempos y costes dependen de fecha y vehículo.
summary.fr: Un modèle de road trip transfrontalier de 20 jours de Lisbonne à Rome via l'Espagne et le sud de la France. Permis, location, péages et accès urbains sont sourcés; routes, temps et coûts dépendent de la date et du véhicule.
summary.pt: Um modelo de road trip transfronteiriço de 20 dias de Lisboa a Roma via Espanha e sul da França. Carta, aluguel, portagens e acessos urbanos têm fontes; estradas, tempos e custos dependem da data e do veículo.

roadTrip.rule: Do not calculate toll, low-emission-zone eligibility, rental permissions or road access without the relevant vehicle and traveller context.

verification.notes: Cross-border driving is feasible in principle, but exact route, tolls, rental permission and urban access depend on vehicle and booking context.
Spanish city access rules are locally regulated; low-emission-zone rules must be checked for the vehicle before entering urban areas.
DGT explicitly advises checking city-specific rules such as ZBE before entering a destination city.
Barcelona and Valencia are represented in Spain's low-emission-zone data; current vehicle restrictions require a date- and vehicle-specific check.
France may require a Crit'Air certificate in low-emission zones; cross-border rental use must be declared to and allowed by the rental company.
Crit'Air/ZFE requirements are vehicle-dependent and should be checked before entering regulated urban zones.
Urban environmental restrictions and motorway tolls must be resolved for the selected vehicle and date.
Rental cross-border permission and motorway tolls are not inferred. Italy's motorway toll depends on route kilometres and vehicle class.
Italian motorway tolls are class- and route-dependent; city-centre access must be checked locally before driving into Florence.
Rome's central ZTL has time-based restrictions for unauthorised vehicles. Exact parking/arrival strategy should be selected before driving into the centre.

message.en: Driving eligibility is not inferred from nationality alone. Licence validity, rental permission, insurance, vehicle registration, urban access and low-emission rules must be resolved against the traveller and vehicle context.
message.de: Die Fahrberechtigung wird nicht allein aus der Nationalität abgeleitet. Führerscheingültigkeit, Mietwagenfreigabe, Versicherung, Zulassung, Stadtzufahrt und Umweltzonen müssen anhand von Traveller- und Vehicle Context geprüft werden.

travellerContext.rule: Road-trip advice must combine traveller context with vehicle context; do not infer licence or vehicle eligibility from locale, IP or route origin.
